summary: Wrote a 14-phase implementation plan adding a state-sharing (branching) witness device alongside the deterministic bi-lasso one. Key research-driven correction to the task description: (C3) BoxFaithful needs no redesign and is reused verbatim; the conditions that break under state-sharing are (C1) LocalCoherentLab and (C2) FulfillingLab, plus a new mandatory atom-coherence condition. ShiftSet.lean is treated as read-only and the deterministic path stays byte-identical, recovered at the end by instantiation plus an explicit frame isomorphism.
